collection.title: Ford Cougar 1998 to 2002 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford Cougar 1998 - 2002 version requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 12" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper. The choice of rear screen wipers for this Cougar which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
